title: WfGg Radar operational discovery and controlled runtime evolution
problem: Functionally verify that V6.19.11 lets a user stop only the currently running manual Radar search from the same UI button, while preserving V6.19.10 production, Last War READ-ONLY guarantees, and non-persistent token handling.
goals: Run the exact qualified V6.19.11 candidate UI on an ephemeral Tailscale-only pilot surface.
Authenticate to Last War for the pilot without persisting the credential outside process memory.
Start one real manual @federated:8120 READ-ONLY search.
Verify RECHERCHER becomes STOP while the manual search is active.
Verify STOP cancels exactly that manual search and terminalizes it as MANUAL_SEARCH_STOPPED.
Verify the UI returns to RECHERCHER after the stop completes.
Preserve V6.19.10 production behavior and all existing safety guards.
non_goals: Do not promote or deploy V6.19.11 to production.
Do not start or stop Autopilot during this functional pilot.
Do not persist the Last War credential to disk, D1, GitHub, logs, or other durable storage.
Do not allow Collector mutations beyond the discovery/evidence/terminalization needed for this one manual search.
Do not accept any functional query other than @federated:8120.

current_change.purpose: End-to-end functional verification of the manual-search STOP control on the exact V6.19.11 candidate.

acceptance_criteria: The functional runner is pinned to approved source revision cbf67e46308e925f1ba5fad0be3f58764231935d and pilot artifact revision 759bfb3fe4620f544cc84fdea34e54bfa3efbdcf.
The exact candidate UI SHA256 is 6e6827e660597549bdc8c4c06e06a644a16215aacabdd20a56993a15f651c060.
The pilot UI is served only on the VPS Tailscale address and is not deployed to Cloudflare production.
The Last War credential remains only in process memory for the pilot and is destroyed when the ephemeral server stops.
Only @federated:8120 is accepted as the functional manual-search query.
The UI transitions RECHERCHER -> STOP -> ARRÊT… -> RECHERCHER.
The active manual job reaches MANUAL_SEARCH_STOPPED after STOP.
The owned Collector cycle is terminal after the stop.
The Radar Connector process is not restarted to implement STOP.
Production promotion or deployment requires a separate explicit human approval.
architecture_invariants: GitHub stores code, branches, CI and release artifacts.
ChaCha DEV on ChaChaVPS is the runtime orchestrator.
ChaChaNas remains authoritative persistent storage for project data and backups.
VPS is runtime-oriented and not the authoritative durable project store.
Producer and verifier responsibilities remain separated.
